# v0.9.0b2 — Charging jobs in the app, all phase values on Total power

Update the app to **0.9.0b2** together with the integration.

- **Breaking: BavarianData 0.9.30 or newer** is required for automatic vehicle
  selection and Virtual Plug & Charge. Its dated **Charging Cable** sensor is
  the only cable source now.
- **Breaking: no automatic cleanup** of the entities folded in 0.9.0b1; delete
  leftover entries in the entity list.
- **Breaking: all phase values on Total power.** While power flows it carries
  the current, voltage and power of L1 to L3 as attributes; the three
  **Current L1–L3** sensors are gone.
- **Breaking: Switch off charging release when unplugged** starts switched off
  once; switch it on again after the update.
- **App: charging jobs, boost and guest charging.** The app runs an energy and
  time order for the plugged-in car on its own, can charge early for up to two
  hours before the planned start, and gives a locally authorized guest a
  bounded order. None of them grants a release or unlocks the wallbox.
- **App: new pages.** **Open Web UI** starts on an overview of the wallbox and
  the last commands; connection settings moved to **Connection**, and new
  pages show the raw registers and apply poll intervals without a restart.
  See [the app's web pages](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.9.0b2/docs/app-guide.md).
- **Departure planning** finishes closer to the departure time and handles the
  exact 6 A boundary; **Plug & Charge** explains why it waits or blocks.
- Many fixes from code reviews, among them: one lost reply no longer marks the
  wallbox as disconnected, a car switch ends the previous car's plan pause, and
  a selected car must confirm the plug-in before its rules apply.

[Changelog](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.9.0b2/CHANGELOG.md)
